value.title: The Toy
value.synopsis: A favorite toy of Theodore's is lost on a rafting trip but then mysteriously shows up at the house, and it's alive.

value.title: Bloodline
value.synopsis: When the boys send Dave's DNA sample to a testing lab the results show he's related to Jack The Ripper.

value.title: Theodore's Calling
value.synopsis: Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life

value.title: Clumsy Jeanette
value.synopsis: Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet. Is there something wrong with her - or her new glasses?

value.title: Adventures in Babysitting
value.synopsis: Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's babysitting sitting job with a spoiled four year old.

value.title: Alvin's Assistant
value.synopsis: Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant to get closer to the music industry, but ends up running errands instead.

value.title: Mysterions
value.synopsis: When Theodore discovers Alvin and Simon have a secret club, he promises not to tell anyone if they let him join.

value.title: The Crow Ate My Homework
value.synopsis: Dave promises to take Alvin to a water park if he gets a good grade on his test, but then a crow steals it.

value.title: Simon Says
value.synopsis: When Alvin accuses Simon of being too safe, Simon agrees to do whatever crazy thing Alvin wants him to do.

value.title: Sing Like a Canary
value.synopsis: A cute singing bird replaces Alvin in the band after Alvin makes too many demands as a performer.

value.title: Pirates Life
value.synopsis: When pirates show up at the house, the boys do all they can to protect a treasure chest that arrived for Dave.

value.title: World Record
value.synopsis: The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game.

value.title: Tour Bus
value.synopsis: When Alvin talks Dave into buying a used tour bus, Dave has no idea of the problems ahead.

value.title: Game Show
value.synopsis: Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts.

value.title: Alvin Management
value.synopsis: When Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, A therapist moves in to help Dave control his anger.

value.title: Time Capsule
value.synopsis: When the school digs up an old high school time capsule, Miss Smith and Dave work together to keep an old secret.

value.title: Munk vs Machine
value.synopsis: The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete in a dodgeball tournament, but no one expects Theo to be their secret weapon.

value.title: Shack Magic
value.synopsis: The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but something more sinister may be afoot.

value.title: Big Bro Theodore
value.synopsis: After a misunderstanding, Theodore thinks he's the oldest brother and tries to be a role model for Alvin and Simon.
